# Anode

> Proof-of-Topology bare-metal orchestrator for unmodified Go backends. Zero Docker, zero Kubernetes. Compiles Go SSA call graphs to hardened systemd units, cgroups v2 quotas, and ephemeral loopbacks with 8ms cold starts and 4.8MB RAM footprint.

## Documentation
- [Quickstart Guide](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/docs#quickstart): Installation via Homebrew or curl, running the analyzer, and deploying.
- [Docker Compose Alternative](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/vs/docker-compose): Detailed technical comparison between Docker Compose and Anode for Go backends.
- [Raw Systemd vs Anode](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/vs/systemd): Why not write systemd unit files manually? Honest tradeoffs and automation.
- [Deploy Go Without Docker](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/guides/deploy-go-without-docker): Step-by-step guide to deploying Go binaries directly to bare-metal systemd.
- [Go + PostgreSQL on VPS](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/guides/deploy-go-postgres-vps): How to build and deploy a Go REST service with PostgreSQL on bare-metal Linux.
- [Deploy Gin Without Docker](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/guides/deploy-gin-without-docker): How to deploy Gin web framework APIs to bare-metal systemd.
- [Deploy Chi Without Docker](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/guides/deploy-chi-without-docker): Deploy lightweight Chi router backends to Linux VPS.
- [Deploy Fiber Without Docker](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/guides/deploy-fiber-without-docker): Run high-throughput Go Fiber apps on systemd with 8ms cold boot.
- [Hetzner VPS Guide](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/deploy/hetzner-vps): How to deploy Go backends to Hetzner Cloud with 8ms cold starts.
- [DigitalOcean Droplet Guide](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/deploy/digitalocean-droplet): How to run Go binaries on DigitalOcean without Docker.
- [Live SSA Call Graph Visualizer](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/tools/ssa-visualizer): Free interactive browser AST simulator to live-synthesize contracts and systemd units.
- [Compose to Systemd Tool](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/tools/compose-to-systemd): Free online client-side Docker Compose to systemd converter.
- [Architecture Deep Dive](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/docs#overview): How Go Single Static Assignment (SSA) and Variable Type Analysis (VTA) synthesize infrastructure topology.
- [The 4 Pillars](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/docs#pillars): Zero-declaration synthesis, ephemeral loopbacks, bare-metal systemd isolation, and deterministic lockfile.
- [Systemd Directives](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/docs#systemd): Hardened service units, cgroups v2 quotas, and automated Caddy reverse proxy routing.
- [Pluggable Catalog Drivers](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/docs#catalog): Database drivers for Postgres, Redis, ClickHouse, MySQL, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ.
- [Tradeoffs & Limitations](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/docs#tradeoffs): When to use Anode vs Docker Compose vs Kubernetes.

## Benchmarks & Engineering Essays
- [Why We Ditched Docker for Go Backends](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/blog/why-we-ditched-docker-for-go-backends): Anatomy of 8ms systemd cold starts and 97% lower daemon memory.
- [Inside the SSA Compiler Core](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/blog/inside-the-ssa-compiler-core): How Variable Type Analysis and backward taint tracking infer infrastructure topology.
- [Ephemeral Loopback Proxies & Zero Port Collisions](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/blog/ephemeral-loopback-proxies-zero-port-collisions): Utilizing the 127.0.0.0/8 loopback subnet and socket splicing.
- [Stress-Testing 10 Real-World Go Backends](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/blog/stress-testing-10-famous-go-backends): Benchmarks across croc, glance, filebrowser, restic, and a 32-service mesh.
- [Zero-Downtime Rolling Restarts](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/blog/zero-downtime-rolling-restarts-linux-sockets): Socket handover and SO_REUSEPORT without dropped connections.
- [DynamicUser Sandboxing](https://anode.abhiudayg.dev/blog/dynamicuser-sandboxing-without-root-daemons): Hardening bare-metal Go backends without root daemons.
- [glance Benchmark](https://github.com/glanceapp/glance): Single-service dashboard analysis and loopback allocation.
- [filebrowser Benchmark](https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser): Multi-store static topology extraction.
- [restic Benchmark](https://github.com/restic/restic): Large Go codebase AST reachability performance.
